old_caption: The video captures a serene sunset scene at a coastal location. The sun is positioned low on the horizon, casting a warm golden glow across the sky and reflecting off the calm waters of the sea. The sky is partially cloudy, with streaks of light breaking through, adding depth to the scene. The beach is visible in the foreground, with gentle waves lapping against the shore. The sand appears dark and textured, contrasting with the bright water. On the right side of the frame, there is a cliff with a building perched on top, silhouetted against the sky. The overall atmosphere is tranquil, with the natural beauty of the sunset creating a peaceful ambiance. There are no animals or characters present in the video; it focuses solely on the natural elements and the stillness of the moment. The camera remains stationary throughout the sequence, allowing viewers to fully absorb the tranquil beauty of the scene.

caption: The video captures a seaside sunset, the sun low on the horizon just left of center, throwing a bright shimmering column across the calm sea. A dark headland topped by a pale building rises on the right, while a sloping sandy-pebbly beach fills the lower foreground and meets a gentle surf line. Layered gray clouds, tinted by the low light, stretch across an overcast sky, and the overall framing of sun and cliff holds steady throughout. A long, low swell is already moving shoreward, its dark trough and crest gradually steepening as it crosses the open water. The sun's reflection continuously shimmers and fractures into moving ripples on the surface. As the swell nears the beach, a band of white breaking foam forms and spreads diagonally across the lower shoreline. This foamy edge widens and creeps closer to the foreground. Meanwhile the thin wash along the right side of the beach recedes and re-forms with the shifting surf. Small surface ripples across the open water quietly reorganize.
